properties.description: Measurements vs Verizon's FCC-filed minimum signal, aggregated to the carrier's own H3 res-9 claimed-coverage hexes. One feature per hex that contained at least one below-claim measurement. Individual GPS points, timestamps, and per-point ids are intentionally omitted; the only coordinates are the FCC filing's fixed hex boundaries, so the drive path cannot be reconstructed. Full-precision point data stays local (see mukoo-claims).
